report_topic: Performance Audit of Implementation of POSHAN including Integrated Child Development Services and Mid-Day Meal
observations_summary: The audit found significant deficiencies in the implementation of POSHAN, ICDS, and MDM schemes, including short lifting/delivery of foodgrains, non-coverage of beneficiaries, inadequate infrastructure, non-functioning devices, and poor monitoring and supervision, leading to beneficiaries being deprived of intended nutritional support.
